title: neo4j.com/partners/solution-partners
snippet:
**Neo4j Solution Partners** include system integrators, strategic consultancies, managed service partners and value-added resellers. Solution partners provide services independently of or alongside Neo4j. As a Neo4j Solution Partner, you gain access to a variety of resources, training, tools and support to build, market and sell with Neo4j.

Neo4j Partners gain access to a variety of resources and support to build, market and sell with Neo4j. Program requirements are intended to preserve the integrity of the Neo4j Partner Program. Acceptance into the Neo4j Partner Program is based on the joint value proposition, solution fit, customer need and level of partner commitment. Solution Partners attain one of two progressive, performance-based tiers: Associate and Premier.
